      public TextInput.Builder styleResolver(StylePropertyResolver resolver)
      Sets the property resolver for style-aware properties.

      When set, properties like color, background, cursor-color, and placeholder-color will be resolved if not set programmatically.

    • masked

      public TextInput.Builder masked()
      Masks the input text with the default mask character ('*').

      When enabled, the actual text is stored but displayed as mask characters. Useful for password fields.

      Returns:
      this builder

      public TextInput.Builder masked(char maskChar)
